summary: Explains that removed features first go through a deprecation cycle with warnings describing why, the alternative, and the version in which removal is planned.
questions: How will I know a feature is going to be removed from Ansible?
What does a deprecation warning in Ansible tell me?

answer_card.title: Deprecation cycles
answer_card.answer_md: Before a feature is removed, it is marked **deprecated**. Users then see warnings explaining why, what to switch to, and in which version the feature is scheduled to be removed.
